sophie_support: Heads-up: Customer reported small rounding mismatch on invoice vs dashboard for EU account acct_9x. Dashboard shows 12.34 EUR, invoice line items sum to 12.33 EUR (diff 0.01). Customer sees VAT breakdown different too. Ticket #INC-983. Copying @jordan_billing for triage.
jordan_billing: Thanks — can you paste the invoice snippet and dashboard export? Suspect per-request rounding + VAT distributed across aggregated lines. :thinking:
sophie_support: Sure, pasted from the PDF and the dashboard CSV: 
```
Invoice lines:
- gen.tokens: 12345 units -> 11.85 EUR
- embeddings.tokens: 678 units -> 0.28 EUR
VAT 20% allocated -> 2.47 EUR
Total invoiced: 12.33 EUR
Dashboard total (raw sums w/ per-request rounding) -> 12.34 EUR
```
omar_finops: What currency/exchange rate used? Was any per-request conversion from USD -> EUR before aggregation?
li_engineer: I can repro locally with metering export. Quick query I ran: 
```
SELECT request_id, raw_cost_eur, ROUND(raw_cost_eur,2) as rounded
FROM meter_requests
WHERE account_id='acct_9x' AND DATE(created_at) = '2026-03-01'
LIMIT 20;
```
I'm seeing many rows where we ROUND() per request and then sum, which can create a cent-level remainder compared to summing raw_cost_eur then rounding the final value.
jordan_billing: Right — billing renderer currently rounds per-line when generating PDF, and our VAT proration logic distributes tax per-line, which can move a cent around. billing-bot, which pipeline is set in prod?
billing-bot: Billing pipeline: stable/v1 uses per-request rounding for VAT proration and per-line rounding in invoice renderer. aggregate-then-round behavior is tracked in billing/rounding-fixes (backlog).
omar_finops: For VAT rules we must show per-line VAT, but total must reconcile. Two approaches: 1) aggregate amounts then round and distribute remainder to largest taxable line; or 2) show a "rounding adjustment" line. Either acceptable to accounting; customer wants reconciliation now.
sophie_support: Customer asks for corrected invoice or credit of 0.01 EUR. Do we have a blocker for issuing a corrected invoice? @jordan_billing
jordan_billing: We can issue a credit memo / corrected invoice. I'll prepare a one-off credit for 0.01 EUR and a corrected PDF. Also creating an engineering task to change renderer to aggregate-then-round with a test to preserve totals. I'll link PR + JIRA.
li_engineer: I'll open the PR — plan: change renderer to compute total_raw = SUM(raw_costs), total_rounded = ROUND(total_raw,2), then compute per-line by prorating from raw_costs but adjust the largest line by (total_rounded - SUM(prorated_rounded)). Add unit test asserting sums equal. Repro steps: export meter_requests for the day, run invoicer locally with both strategies, diff PDFs.
sophie_support: :thumbsup: Please update ticket INC-983 with the credit note id and share corrected invoice with the customer. I'll confirm with them once done.
jordan_billing: Will do. Filing credit now and assigning eng task to li_engineer. I'll post links when available.
li_engineer: PR opened and tests added, referencing INC-983. Will monitor for regressions in staging.
sophie_support: Thanks team — closing loop on customer after credit sent.
